description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Token_Text, which represents text tokens (including PCDATA and CDATA content) used within the HTMLPurifier library. It contains properties for storing the token data and whether it is whitespace, and a constructor for initializing these properties.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Text
classes.description: A class representing text tokens such as PCDATA and CDATA within the HTMLPurifier system. It extends HTMLPurifier_Token and manages token data, whitespace status, and metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of HTMLPurifier_Token_Text with provided data, and optionally line and column info. Determines if the data is whitespace.
